description: Intercept/stub network responses (e.g. mock APIs) OR retrieve captured network telemetry: per-request TLS/SSL certificate details (when the connection exposes them), millisecond timing phases, and failure reasons.

action.description: Action to perform: 'enable'/'disable' network response interception, 'get_telemetry' to read captured requests with TLS/SSL certs & timing breakdown, or 'clear_telemetry' to reset buffer.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

mockBody.description: JSON or plaintext body payload to return in the mocked response.

mockStatus.description: HTTP status code to return when enabling mock (default 200).

pattern.description: URL glob pattern to intercept or filter telemetry (e.g. '*api/login*').

name: browser_network_intercept
